mapper.insert: insert into repro_events ( tenant_id, house_id, cycle_id, litter_id, mother_rabbit_id, batch_id, cage_id, operation_code, target_type, target_id, event_type, from_stage, to_stage, occurred_at, payload, operator_id, operator_name, request_id, create_time ) values ( #{tenantId}, #{houseId}, #{cycleId}, #{litterId}, #{motherRabbitId}, #{batchId}, #{cageId}, coalesce(#{operationCode}, 'repro:state-machine'), coalesce(#{targetType}, 'RABBIT'), coalesce(#{targetId}, #{motherRabbitId}), #{eventType}, #{fromStage}, #{toStage}, #{occurredAt}, #{payload}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{requestId}, now() )

insert into repro_events ( tenant_id, house_id, cycle_id, litter_id, mother_rabbit_id, batch_id, cage_id, operation_code, target_type, target_id, event_type, from_stage, to_stage, occurred_at, payload, operator_id, operator_name, request_id, create_time ) values
( #{event.tenantId}, #{event.houseId}, #{event.cycleId}, #{event.litterId}, #{event.motherRabbitId}, #{event.batchId}, #{event.cageId}, #{event.operationCode}, #{event.targetType}, #{event.targetId}, #{event.eventType}, #{event.fromStage}, #{event.toStage}, #{event.occurredAt}, #{event.payload}, #{event.operatorId}, #{event.operatorName}, #{event.requestId}, now() )
on duplicate key update create_time = create_time
mapper.select: select * from repro_events where house_id = #{houseId} and request_id = #{requestId} order by id limit 1
